description: This file contains platform-specific functions for upgrading firmware and copying configurations for particular hardware boards in an OpenWRT project, including checks and procedures for emmc upgrades.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity of the image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process based on board type, calling appropriate upgrade functions.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration during upgrade for specific hardware boards.
